Last night, President Donald J. Trump sat down with 60 Minutes following the midterm elections and made a powerful case for his America First record. President Trump highlighted the booming Trump economy — 165,000 new jobs in October, record 401(k) balances, and hundreds of billions of dollars in new factories — touted the most secure border in history, detailed the decisive blows he has dealt to Iran’s nuclear program, explained why America must win the Super Intelligence race, and much more.

Key exchanges:

  • On the midterms: “I think if I was on the ballot, it would’ve been a much different situation… But there’s something beyond that. They didn’t like the war. They didn’t like the fact that gasoline went up… And there’s a great dislike, incredibly, for Israel.” (Watch)
  • On the stock market: “We have historically good numbers. We have the highest stock market in history.” (Watch)
    • Since President Trump was elected, the S&P 500 has hit 77 new record highs, the Nasdaq has hit 70 record highs, and the Dow has hit 51 record highs. Since Inauguration Day, the S&P 500 has hit 67 record highs, the Nasdaq has hit 60 record highs, and the Dow has hit 43 record highs.
  • On jobs numbers: “The numbers are way beyond anybody’s expectations… We had 165,000 jobs created just in a short time.” (Watch)
    • The U.S. economy added 165,000 new jobs in October — smashing economists’ expectations; manufacturing added 19,000 jobs in October and the sector has added more than 100,000 jobs since its December 2025 low.
  • On retirement savings: “401(k)s are at their all-time high by a lot. Under other Presidents, they were a disaster. 401(k)s have made people rich.”  (Watch)
    • 401(k), 403(b), and IRA balances hit new highs in the second quarter of 2026, with the average 401(k) balance reaching a record $155,800 — up 13.1% from a year earlier.
  • On private investment: “There has never been a time where there is the activity — trillions and trillions of dollars right now, as we sit, is being built. In a year from now… many of those plants are gonna be open, operating.” (Watch)
    • Companies are pouring money into America, including Apple ($600 billion and 20,000 new American hires), NVIDIA (up to $500 billion in American-made SI infrastructure), TSMC ($165 billion in the largest single foreign direct investment in U.S. history), and Johnson & Johnson (more than $55 billion).
  • On reshoring auto manufacturing: “We’re also building automobile factories like we’ve never built before.” (Watch)
    • Audi is building its first-ever U.S. plant in Georgia, with a $4 billion investment that will create about 4,500 new jobs.
  • On reshoring pharmaceutical manufacturing: “How about pharmaceutical? Eli Lilly, Merck, Pfizer — they’re building hundreds of billions of [investment].” (Watch)
    • Eli Lilly has committed more than $50 billion to American manufacturing, Merck has committed more than $70 billion, and Pfizer has committed an additional $70 billion as part of its landmark agreement with the Trump Administration to lower drug prices.
  • On securing the border: “I think I got an A+ for closing up the border… I get very high marks for getting the bad ones out.” (Watch)
    • Border Patrol recorded just 98,708 southwest border apprehensions in FY2026 — the lowest in agency history and a 95% drop from the Biden-era average — while September marked the 17th straight month of zero releases at the border.
  • On Iran: “You can’t let Iran have a nuclear weapon. I think, historically, this will be a very good decision. Is it a good decision for today and tomorrow? Maybe not, but I have to go with what’s right for our country.” (Watch)
  • On the Strait of Hormuz: “The strait is open, Ross… Your favorite newspaper, The Wall Street Journal… had an article that said, ‘There’s more oil going through the Hormuz Strait than there was at the beginning of the war.’ Think of that.” (Watch)
    • The Wall Street Journal reports that Persian Gulf oil exports have surpassed prewar levels — more than 24 million barrels a day — thanks to a shipping system under U.S. protection.
  • On Venezuela: “I just say the Venezuela attack will go down in military histories… It was one of the most incredible attacks anyone’s ever seen. They left the aircraft carriers at 1:00 in the morning, pitch black. Everything went perfect.” (Watch)
  • On the Russia-Ukraine war: “I believe that war is going to end and it’s going to end soon, and the only reason it’s going to end is because of me.” (Watch)
  • On Super Intelligence: “The reason I’m an AI bull, one of the reasons, is because President Xi left here two weeks ago — we had a great meeting — he’s all-in to SI… Whoever wins that race wins.” (Watch)
  • On data centers: “China has no problem with data centers. China has no problem with electricity. And, by the way, we don’t either because… I’m demanding that they build their own electric plant.” (Watch)
  • On MAGA: “MAGA is basically common sense. MAGA is strong borders, good military — we have created wealth at a level that our country has never seen before.” (Watch)
  • On 2028: “We have a tremendous bench.” (Watch)
  • On how his presidency will be remembered: “That I made America great again.” (Watch)

This morning, Attorney General Todd Blanche appeared on the Sunday shows and made clear that the Department of Justice will fulfill its Constitutional duty to represent the Executive Branch — and that Democrats’ explicit threats of endless investigations, impeachments, and retribution against President Trump, Cabinet officials, and private citizens will not succeed.

Key exchanges:

  • On Democrats’ threats against donors, students, and private citizens: “They’ve threatened donors, they’ve threatened individuals who are in college and might want to work for conservative institutions or for a conservative government or for President Trump, and that is extremely troubling. It should be troubling to everybody in this country.” (Watch)
  • On Democrats’ claims of “oversight” vs. political retribution: “Have you been listening to the rhetoric the past couple days? You honestly think that all they’re doing is talking about their oversight obligations when they’re talking about going after basically every member of the cabinet? They’re talking about impeachments; they’re talking about going after private companies who happen to have made investments in this country over the past couple years. That is NOT oversight.” (Watch)
  • On the DOJ’s role in representing Administration officials: “In every Administration, the Department of Justice represents members of the executive who are brought in front of Congress. So, there is nothing unique to me saying that. Every Attorney General in history represents members of the Administration… I would suggest [Rep. Garcia] read the Constitution. If he doesn’t have a copy, I can arrange to send him one — but the Constitution absolutely protects members of the executive.” (Watch)
  • On Democrats recycling the same playbook: “This is literally déjà vu all over again. They’ve tried this before. It didn’t work last time; it’s not going to work this time.” (Watch)
  • On Stephen Miller as Chief of Staff: “[Miller] will be a phenomenal Chief of Staff. The reason why you saw immediate complaints about Stephen is really fear, and they’re worried about what’s going to happen because he’s so good at his job.” (Watch)

Today, President Donald J. Trump announced the appointment of Stephen Miller as the 33rd White House Chief of Staff, succeeding Susie Wiles after her highly successful tenure. Miller has served alongside President Trump since the very beginning and has been a driving force behind the Administration’s major successes — driving violent crime to historic lows, securing the border at unprecedented levels, and dismantling large-scale fraud. He brings deep experience, broad institutional knowledge, and unwavering commitment to the role.

The news was met with widespread praise:

Vice President JD Vance: “Very grateful to Susie for her friendship and service to the president and our country. Stephen Miller is an amazing patriot and will do great things. Congrats to him on a well deserved promotion!”

Secretary of State Marco Rubio: “Susie Wiles served our country with exceptional strength, devotion, and grace. She has done an incredible job serving our country and President Trump. I am grateful for her service, her friendship, and I wish her continued success in her next chapter. I look forward to continuing to work with Stephen Miller, one of the President’s most trusted and longtime advisors, to advance the President’s agenda.”

Secretary of War Pete Hegseth: “Huge CONGRATS to @StephenM — a true patriot and America First fighter. He never backs down — and the @DeptofWar is right there with him.”

Attorney General Todd Blanche: “A huge thank you to Susie Wiles for her incredible service to our nation! She’s a rockstar and will no doubt continue working to make our country great. Looking forward to continuing our work with my good friend Stephen Miller as Chief. Together we’ve reduced crime to historic levels, enhanced public safety throughout our communities, and continue to root out the massive fraud that has taken advantage of American taxpayers. We’re not slowing down.”

Secretary of the Interior Doug Burgum: “@SusieWiles47 is a talented leader and tireless champion for the American people. Her relentless determination and unwavering commitment to our country have set an example for everyone in this administration. America is better because of her service, and I’m grateful to have had the opportunity to work alongside her. Looking forward to working with @StephenM in his new role as we continue the Golden Age of America!”

Secretary of Agriculture Brooke Rollins: “Thank you, @SusieWiles47! From helping lead President Trump’s historic comeback to serving as the first woman White House Chief of Staff, you’ve led with kindness and resolve. It has been a privilege to serve alongside you and I will never forget those early 2021 days when only a few of us were in the arena. And speaking of just a few of us in the arena back then… Congratulations to @StephenM! You and Katie are true patriots. Excited to continue our work together on fraud, making school lunches healthy again, and bringing real prosperity back to rural America. No worthier causes than these and no better leader than you to make it so. There’s more work ahead to deliver @POTUS’ America First agenda, and we’re ready. Let’s get it done!”

Secretary of Labor Keith Sonderling: “Congratulations to @StephenM on becoming @WhiteHouse Chief of Staff. I have had the privilege of working alongside Stephen during both Trump Administrations. I know firsthand the dedication, work ethic, and commitment that he will bring to the Chief of Staff position and I look forward to working with him to continue delivering on @POTUS’ agenda as he steps into his new role.”

Secretary of Health and Human Services Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.: “Next to me, Stephen Miller is the strongest MAHA supporter in the administration. It’s time to unleash the Kraken.”

Secretary of Housing and Urban Development Scott Turner: “@StephenM is a true patriot. Thanks to his partnership, President Trump put an end to government control of suburbs, improved housing affordability, and enhanced accountability in public benefit programs. He is fearless, focused, and ready to drive President Trump’s agenda for the American people. He will do a great job!”

Secretary of Energy Chris Wright: “Congratulations to @StephenM on his appointment as White House Chief of Staff. I’ve appreciated Stephen’s partnership and his unwavering commitment to delivering on President Trump’s vision for America. I look forward to continuing our work together. And a heartfelt thank you to @SusieWiles47 for her exceptional leadership, friendship, and service to our country.”

Secretary of Education Linda McMahon: “Congratulations to @StephenM! We’ve been in this fight together for a long time, and I look forward to continuing our work to Make America Great Again! A legacy of distinguished service as our nation’s first female White House Chief of Staff. Thank you, @SusieWiles47, for your extraordinary leadership!”

Secretary of Homeland Security Markwayne Mullin: “Excited for my friend @StephenM. President Trump made an excellent choice by choosing him as his chief of staff. Under @SusieWiles47’s leadership, I personally learned a great deal from her on how she handled personal adversity and balanced a strong work ethic. It’s an honor to be in the fight with so many great America First patriots.”

Director of the Office of Management and Budget Russ Vought: “Congratulations to @StephenM who will do an incredible job for President Trump as the new Chief of Staff! He is a world class talent and deeply committed to the President and the America First agenda. He will do great!”

Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency Lee Zeldin: “Stephen Miller is an incredibly talented fighter who’s been by President Trump’s side from DAY ONE. He’s ready…always! Few are as sharp, loyal, and relentless in delivering for the President. A tried, true, and battle tested patriot.”

Director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation Kash Patel: “Susie has been an amazing leader for the team the last two years. I am grateful for her partnership and dedication to this administration and know @SusieWiles47 will continue to do great work serving the President’s outside operation. I look forward to working with @StephenM as our new White House Chief of Staff. Stephen has been a friend and colleague since the first Trump administration. I know his resolve and his commitment to this country, and I have no doubt he’ll bring both to leading this team for President Trump.”

Administrator of the Social Security Administration Frank Bisignano: “Congratulations @StephenM on being named WH Chief of Staff. I look forward to continuing our work together on behalf of American taxpayers, protecting the integrity of our programs at @SocialSecurity & @IRSnews. Thank you @SusieWiles47 for your historic service to our nation.”

Administrator of NASA Jared Isaacman: “Congrats to @StephenM, the new White House Chief of Staff”

Director of the Federal Housing Finance Agency Bill Pulte: “Congratulations to my dear friend and colleague, Stephen Miller, on your promotion to Chief of Staff. I can’t wait to work with you!”

White House Communications Director Steven Cheung: “Stephen Miller is a Trump OG, someone who has been with the President since the very beginning. There is no bigger advocate for the Trump agenda than Stephen, and he will help the Administration deliver on monumental victories for the rest of this historic second term.”

White House Senior Counselor for Trade and Manufacturing Peter Navarro: “Big congrats to @StephenM, new Chief of Staff! I’ve been in Trump trenches with this MAGA warrior since 2016. As Trump’s top speechwriter, he helped forge MAGA vision. China hawk. Border warrior. Blue-collar to core. @realDonaldTrump sends strongest of signals to MAGA base! (This photo celebrated exit from horrible Trans-Pacific Partnership trade deal–one of first promises of 2016 campaign kept.)”

Former White House Deputy Chief of Staff Taylor Budowich: “Many people know Stephen for his fierce loyalty to the President, but more than that, he is the administration’s most organized and competent operator. He has built and managed one of the most effective policy teams in American history. He was born to be Donald Trump’s Chief of Staff.”

Former White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt: “Susie Wiles is one of the kindest and toughest people I’ve ever met. She helped power the greatest political comeback in American history in 2024, and as the first woman to serve as White House Chief of Staff, she led the most productive start to a presidency in decades, even while battling breast cancer. I’m proud to call her my friend and former boss. President Trump made the perfect choice in naming my dear friend Stephen Miller to succeed her. No one is more loyal, more hardworking, or more in touch with the America First movement than Stephen. I have complete confidence that he will make the final two years of the President’s term a resounding success. Now is the time to fix what’s not working and double down on all of the victories we’ve already achieved. What we cannot do is fall into despair and hand the country over to the Radical Democrats.”

Former White House Chief of Staff Mark Meadows: “This was a phenomenal selection by President Trump. Stephen Miller is a friend, but more importantly he’s an incredibly competent leader who understands Capitol Hill and the federal government.”

Former White House Press Secretary Kayleigh McEnany: “Stephen Miller is someone who, for six years — more than that, ten years at this point — has worked aside the President… He’s a thought leader in the conservative movement and I think he is vastly underestimated by the Left.”

Florida Gov.-elect Byron Donalds: “My dear friend Susie Wiles led a brilliant 2024 campaign and served as Chief of Staff with strength, grace, and unparalleled leadership. She is a titan who has my utmost respect and gratitude. Congratulations to Stephen Miller. He is a patriot who has been with President Trump since day one and will work tirelessly for the American people.”

Louisiana Gov. Jeff Landry: “I think it’s a great choice… Stephen Miller is exactly the type of person you want standing next to the President.”

Sen. Jim Banks: “Congrats, @StephenM! Excellent pick by POTUS”

Sen. Katie Britt: “Thank you, @SusieWiles47, for your tremendous service to our country. From being the first woman to serve as Chief of Staff in our country’s history to bravely battling breast cancer, Susie has been an inspiration to millions across the country. Congratulations, @StephenM, on your new role. I look forward to continue working together to deliver results for the American people.”

Sen. Bill Hagerty: “Congratulations to my friend, @StephenM, on being named @POTUS new Chief of Staff. And thank you, @SusieWiles, for your dedication and service to President Trump’s administration. I look forward to seeing the outstanding work you will both continue to do in service of our great nation.”

Sen. Mike Lee: “Stephen Miller has been a true conservative warrior since his days as a Senate staffer, a staunch defender of law and order against illegal invasions and leftist lawlessness, and a steadfast fighter for President Trump for over a decade. He will be an excellent White House Chief of Staff!”

Sen. Cynthia Lummis: “@SusieWiles47 made history as the first woman White House Chief of Staff, serving the President with honor and distinction. I’m grateful for all she’s done for President Trump and our country. I also want to Congratulate @StephenM on being named as her successor. I’m confident he’ll do an outstanding job.”

Sen. Eric Schmitt: “Our country is at a pivotal point and Stephen Miller understands exactly what is at stake. He will be an outstanding Chief of Staff. Congratulations to @StephenM, and thank you to Susie Wiles for her service to our country.”

Sen. Rick Scott: “Congratulations to @SusieWiles, who has done an excellent job delivering for the American people at the White House. Susie is a fighter, she loves working for the American people, and has helped @POTUS accomplish so much that truly delivers for hardworking families. I know she’ll keep up the good fight in her new role. I’ve known @StephenM for years and look forward to working with him to Make Washington Work for every family. We must be relentlessly focused on building the American economy, growing American jobs, and keeping the American Dream alive.”

House Majority Whip Tom Emmer: “Thank you, @SusieWiles47, for your unwavering dedication and service to President Trump and the American people. Her strong leadership has helped guide our nation through a pivotal moment in history, and we wish her the very best in her next chapter. Congratulations to @StephenM on becoming White House Chief of Staff! President Donald J. Trump has long said that America is the hottest country in the world — and today’s blockbuster jobs report delivers the proof. The economy added a massive 165,000 new jobs in October, more than double what experts expected, with the unemployment rate falling, manufacturing surging, prior months revised sharply higher, and broad-based gains. Experts agree: this is a booming labor market.

Here’s what they’re saying:

Edward Jones Senior Global Strategist Angelo Kourkafas: “This was a blowout jobs report. Payroll growth exceeded expectations, revisions were positive, the unemployment rate fell, participation improved, and wage growth strengthened.”

EY-Parthenon Chief Economist Gregory Daco: “It’s as good as can be, really.”

Allianz Trade North America Senior Economist Dan North: “You have to look pretty hard to find something to dislike in there. It’s a really, really good report, and all around I think you’d say it’s stronger than expected and the best one in a while, and it kind of fits with what I call the stable but perhaps unexciting labor market.”

Edward Jones Head of Investment Strategy Mona Mahajan: “This is a strong number. It supports the view that the underlying fundamentals of this economy have held in there. We’ve seen a strong manufacturing economy, we’ve seen a strong services economy, and we see a pretty robust labor market.”

Principal Asset Management Chief Global Strategist Seema Shah: “Today’s jobs report is a strong rebuttal to fears that the economy is heading into a meaningful slowdown. Payrolls growth surprised firmly to the upside, unemployment fell back to 4.1%, and job creation remains broad-based, pointing to an economy that is still absorbing labor comfortably rather than one beginning to buckle under tighter financial conditions.”

Fitch Ratings Head of U.S. Economics Olu Sonola: “Strength on strength. This is a very strong labor-market report on the heels of solid GDP and consumer-spending data last week, reinforcing the economy’s positive momentum.”

Bloomberg Senior Editor Chris Anstey: “It’s worth noting that, with the October gain in factory payrolls, total manufacturing employment is now a net positive since Trump returned to office.”

Navy Federal Credit Union Chief Economist Heather Long: “A blowout jobs report. The US economy added 165,000 jobs in October. That’s above expectations of ~65k. August and September also revised a lot higher. There was a big surge in professional and biz services hiring (+70k!), along with ongoing gains in healthcare and transportation”

Former Obama Council of Economic Advisers Chair Jason Furman: “If you pay attention to numbers obsessively day-to-day you can miss the bigger picture. And the bigger picture is that this might be the best–or among the best–job markets we’ve ever had–as measured by delivering jobs for people that want them.”

Bloomberg Global Head of Market Innovation Michael McDonough: “A much stronger U.S. jobs picture. Payrolls rose 165k in October, topping every forecast in the Bloomberg survey. The 3-month moving average has now climbed to 137k, up from just 28k in July and the strongest since May. The improvement is also broadening: professional & business services, education & health, trade/transportation, and manufacturing are all making meaningful contributions.”

Economist Steve Moore: “The Trump economy is creating opportunities for Americans who know how to do things. Employers need electricians, welders, mechanics and skilled tradesmen, not another generation of gender studies majors. The jobs are out there. We need workers with the skills to fill them!”

TD Securities Head of U.S. Economics Oscar Munoz: “The report was broadly strong.”

Bloomberg Intelligence strategist Ira Jersey: “There’s nothing weak in the report at all except the underemployment rate moving a bit higher, but the rest of the underlying data was solid.”

Economist E.J. Antoni: “Productive private sector added 159k jobs last month while gov’t added just 6k – great to see growth coming from the real economy and not the bloated bureaucracy in Washington”

The Washington Post reporter Lauren Kaori Gurley: “The U.S. economy added 165,000 jobs in October, shattering expectations and suggesting new strength in the labor market, especially for white collar, health care and manufacturing workers.”

The New York Times business reporter Sydney Ember: “Hiring was unexpectedly strong in October, when employers added workers at a vigorous pace. Employers added 165,000 jobs last month, the Bureau of Labor Statistics reported Friday, and the unemployment rate dropped to 4.1 percent. Job gains for August and September were revised upward by a total of 84,000 positions. Average hourly earnings rose 3.1 percent compared with the same time last year.”

Fox Business Network host Taylor Riggs: “Huge numbers to report for the month of October. Nonfarm payrolls come in at 165,000… 100,000 over where we thought it would be.”

Secretary of Labor Keith Sonderling: “The American labor market is the strongest it has been in more than half a century, and President Trump’s leadership continues to drive job growth in the United States as the unemployment rate dropped to 4.1% and we added 165,000 new jobs. Since the President took office, we have surpassed 1.25 million new private sector jobs and doubled the monthly breakeven rate. The manufacturing sector has added more than 100,000 jobs in 2026, including 19,000 in October. This historic growth is driven by trillions of dollars of domestic investment that President Trump has secured. Initial jobless claims fell to 189,000 last week, matching the lowest level recorded since 1969. We are now in the 10th consecutive month of manufacturing expansion, and the combination of reshored production, record investment, and the Working Families Tax Cuts is delivering economic security for the nation.”

Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent: “Thanks to America’s unrivaled entrepreneurial spirit and dynamism, the re-industrialization and re-privatization of the American economy are gathering extraordinary force. Today’s jobs report shows our great American companies have created nearly 400,000 private-sector jobs in the past three months. Manufacturing employment has now risen by over 100,000 in 2026 alone. We are fundamentally rebalancing the American economy, away from government-led growth and toward private investment, productive employment, and the revival of our industrial base.”

Director of the National Economic Council Kevin Hassett: “We have a jobs report that was way more than double expectation, and the upward revisions were ginormous… What we’ve got is a job market that’s hitting on all cylinders.”

Administrator of the Small Business Administration Kelly Loeffler: “Today’s jobs report blew past experts’ forecasts once again with strong growth across sectors. Manufacturing added 19k more jobs in Oct, which is over 100k manufacturing jobs added since Dec 2025. 98% of manufacturers are small businesses! Made in America is coming back thanks to @POTUS – and with it, good-paying jobs and stronger communities.”

Secretary of Housing and Urban Development Scott Turner: “The U.S. economy added 165,000 jobs. 100,000 more than expected. @POTUS is delivering for the American people. More paychecks mean more families who can save, qualify, and buy.”

  • 36% of equipment manufacturers have reshored or are reshoring, and 63% are making capital investments to expand U.S. production.
  • U.S. manufacturing expanded for a 10th straight month.
  • Core capital goods orders are up almost 14% from a year ago and are on track for a record share this year.
  • The economy grew 3.4% in the third quarter, once again defying the experts.

Prescription drug prices are plummeting for the first time in decades under the leadership of President Donald J. Trump — delivering real, measurable relief to millions of Americans. In City Journal, Dr. Joel Zinberg explains why this is a major accomplishment:

“Yet few Americans realize that drug prices—a major complaint—are actually falling.

The Consumer Price Index for prescription drugs has either fallen or been flat every month of 2026. The latest inflation data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics show that while the overall CPI rose 3.7 percent year to year, prescription drug prices fell 4.5 percent—the largest year-over-year decline since 1963—and nonprescription prices fell 0.9 percent…

The Trump administration has pursued multiple policies to bring drug prices down. TrumpRx, launched in February 2026, provides cash-paying patients with large discounts on over 800 drugs, including many of the most popular medicines. Chief among these are the GLP-1 weight-loss drugs. U.S. prescription drug spending surged in 2025, driven by increased utilization of the GLP-1s tirzepatide and semaglutide at approximately $60 billion each. Consumers’ use of the TrumpRx discounts—particularly for GLP-1s—has been a major factor in lowering prescription prices throughout 2026.

Agreements with pharmaceutical companies Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk reduce the cost of GLP-1 medications for government programs and TrumpRx while expanding Medicare coverage for obesity with a $50 monthly copay. TrumpRx prices are most valuable to uninsured patients and those whose private plans do not cover GLP-1s to treat obesity. (Less than a third of employer-provided health plans cover GLP-1s for obesity.) By providing low, transparent prices to consumers, these programs create downward pressure on drug prices in all insurance plans.”

Paychecks are rising faster than inflation. And companies are investing trillions to build their futures in America.

  • Manufacturing jobs are coming back. Manufacturers have added 72,000 jobs this year, reversing the 202,000 manufacturing jobs lost in the final two years of the Biden Administration. Employment in factory construction has climbed by nearly 112,000 since President Trump took office.
  • Paychecks are growing. Manufacturing workers’ weekly earnings are up 5% over the past year — outpacing inflation and boosting purchasing power.
  • Investment is accelerating. Business investment jumped 12.7% in the third quarter of 2026, the fastest growth in 15 years. Private investment in plants and equipment rose 9.4% — more than twice the 2025 rate and triple the pace of Biden’s final year. Capital goods imports hit a record share of total goods imports in September while consumer goods imports fell to a historic low, signaling businesses are equipping American factories, not just importing finished products.
  • Demand for American machinery is strong. U.S. machine tool orders reached their third-highest monthly total on record, up more than 36% from a year earlier.

Companies are matching the momentum with major new commitments. In just the past few weeks:

  • Audi announced a $4 billion factory in Georgia — its first U.S. manufacturing plant — creating 4,500 jobs.
  • Westinghouse Electric announced a $1 billion investment in South Carolina to build a next-generation nuclear fuel factory.
  • U.S. Steel announced a $3 billion investment near Pittsburgh to construct a new hot strip mill and increase annual capacity by roughly 1.3 million tons.
  • Apple announced up to $100 million to strengthen American titanium production.
  • Bombardier announced $270 million in U.S. manufacturing investment, creating thousands of jobs.
  • Carrier announced more than $600 million in an advanced manufacturing facility in Fort Worth.

More jobs. Rising wages. New factories. Record investment. Under President Trump, American manufacturing is being rebuilt — and made great again.

  • Four doubleheaders. President Trump held two events in a single day in Denton, TX, and Durant, OK (October 1); Bullhead City, AZ, and Kalispell, MT (October 14); Corpus Christi, TX, and Lubbock, TX (October 27); and Dubuque, IA, and Salina, KS (November 1).

President Donald J. Trump has executed the most sweeping restoration of American sovereignty, strength, and prosperity in modern history. With ferocious speed and resolve, President Trump has reversed decades of decline, kept more promises than any modern President, and delivered results for working families that once seemed impossible.

Here are 127 Promises Made, Promises Kept from President Trump’s second term:

Ending the Border Invasion and Restoring American Sovereignty

  • PROMISE MADE: “We will close the border. We will stop the invasion of illegals into our country.” (10/12/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: Under President Trump, illegal crossings at the southern border have collapsed to the lowest levels in American history after his rapid action to close the border on Day One. In FY 2026, Border Patrol recorded just 98,708 southwest border apprehensions — a 95% drop from the more than 1.8 million per year under Biden — and nationwide encounters fell to the lowest in the agency’s history.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I will send troops to the southern border to repel the disastrous invasion of our country.” (1/20/25)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: On Day One, President Trump declared a national emergency at the southern border and deployed thousands of military personnel to protect it — establishing National Defense Areas where illegal crossers can be charged with trespassing on a military installation.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I will immediately end the Biden border nightmare that traffickers are using to exploit vulnerable women and children.” (7/21/23)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: The number of unaccompanied illegal migrant children crossing into the country remains near a record-low, with Customs and Border Protection encountering just 763 unaccompanied minors at the southern border in August 2026 — down nearly 95% from the 14,237 encountered in August 2023 under Biden.

  • PROMISE MADE: “325,000 children are missing or dead. They came through the border… 325,000 children went through her stupid open border, and now they’re either missing, dead, or slaves. If you want to end this disaster, you must get out and vote.” (11/1/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: After the Biden Administration lost track of 325,000 migrant children, the Trump Administration has located over 157,000 — fulfilling President Trump’s promise to do everything possible to save child victims of human trafficking.

  • PROMISE MADE: “Under my leadership, we will seal it up and expand that wall until we have total control.” (3/4/23)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump immediately resumed construction of the border wall, securing a historic $46.5 billion to build it as part of the Working Families Tax Cuts. CBP has completed 250 miles of new border barrier since January 20, 2025, and has obligated $34.3 billion to Smart Wall projects since September 2025.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I will end catch-and-release.” (10/12/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump ended catch-and-release on Day One. FY2026 was the first fiscal year in American history with zero Border Patrol releases, and the Trump Administration has not released a single illegal alien from the border into the U.S. interior for 17 straight months.

  • PROMISE MADE: “We will reinstate my Remain in Mexico policy.” (1/20/25)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: Soon after taking office, President Trump reinstated the “Remain in Mexico” policy — ensuring would-be illegal border crossers are not able to wait with little consequence in the U.S. for the resolution of their cases.

  • PROMISE MADE: “To further deter illegal immigration, I will sign on Day One [an] Executive Order ending automatic citizenship for the children of illegal aliens.” (7/1/23)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump immediately signed an Executive Order ending birthright citizenship for the children of illegal immigrants.

  • PROMISE MADE: “Kamala’s app for illegals will be shut down immediately — within 24 hours.” (10/12/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump ended the app’s use almost immediately after taking office and repurposed it as a mechanism for self-deportation.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I will… suspend refugee admissions, stop the resettlement, and keep the terrorists the hell out of our country.” (7/27/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump suspended refugee resettlement on Day One and slashed refugee admissions by more than 80%. He terminated Temporary Protected Status for 13 countries, including Somalia, Venezuela, and Haiti, and reduced the number of so-called “asylum seekers” entering the U.S. through ports of entry by a staggering 99.9%.

  • PROMISE MADE: “On Day One, I will immediately restore and expand the Trump travel ban.” (10/23/23)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump restored the travel ban in June 2025 and expanded it in December, imposing full entry restrictions on nationals of 19 high-risk countries.

Launching the Largest Deportation Operation in American History

  • PROMISE MADE: “We will begin the largest deportation operation in the history of our country.” (10/21/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: The illegal alien population has been reduced by at least 2.3 million, with more than three million illegal aliens leaving the country — including nearly 1.2 million who have been deported or removed. ICE has carried out nearly 1.3 million arrests, more than doubled its ranks of officers and agents, and secured more than 2,500 partnerships with state and local law enforcement, and President Trump signed the Secure America Act to deliver $70 billion more for ICE and CBP. In 2025, America recorded negative net migration for the first time in at least 50 years.

  • PROMISE MADE: “The drug cartels are waging war on America — and it’s now time for America to wage war on the cartels” (12/22/23); “We will expel every single illegal alien gang member and migrant criminal operating on American soil and remove the savage gang, Tren de Aragua, from the United States.” (1/19/25)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump designated more than ten Latin American cartels — including Tren de Aragua, MS-13, and Clan del Golfo — as terrorist organizations, invoked the Alien Enemies Act, and has arrested more than 12,100 gang members, including more than 1,500 Tren de Aragua and nearly 2,000 MS-13 affiliates. Through Operation Southern Spear, the U.S. military has struck more than 70 narco-terrorist vessels, and in Operation Absolute Resolve, U.S. forces captured indicted narco-terrorist dictator Nicolás Maduro and brought him to face justice in New York.

  • PROMISE MADE: “My administration will deliver justice for every family whose loved one has been stolen from them by migrant crime, including Laken Riley, Rachel Morin, Jocelyn Nungaray, Kayla Hamilton, and every other precious American soul that we have lost to these animals. Their memories will live in their hearts forever and our hearts forever, and we will never, ever forget them.” (1/19/25)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump signed the Laken Riley Act into law as his first legislative victory of his second term. The bill mandates the detention and deportation of illegal alien criminals and allows states to sue if immigration laws aren’t enforced.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I’m hereby calling for the death penalty for any migrant that kills an American citizen or a law enforcement officer.” (10/12/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump directed the Department of Justice to pursue the death penalty in capital crimes committed by illegal immigrants.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I am announcing a new plan to end all sanctuary cities in North Carolina and all across our country… and we will bring down the full weight of the federal government on any jurisdiction that refuses to cooperate.” (9/21/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: The Trump Administration has targeted so-called “sanctuary” jurisdictions giving safe harbor to criminal illegal immigrants — terminating sanctuary policies in Washington, D.C., and moving to strip federal funding from sanctuary jurisdictions nationwide.

Restoring Law and Order in American Communities

  • PROMISE MADE: “We will make America safe again.” (11/4/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: In 2025, the U.S. murder rate fell 18.1% — tying the lowest rate ever recorded — and violent crime posted the largest annual drop on record. In the first half of 2026, violent crime fell another 10.6% and murders dropped another 23%. Drug overdose deaths have fallen more than 40% from the Biden-era peak.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I will crack down on the left-wing jurisdictions that refuse to prosecute dangerous criminals and set loose violent felons on cashless bail.” (4/2/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump signed an Executive Order to ensure federal policies and resources are not used to support cashless bail policies across the nation.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I am pleased to inform our many U.S.A. Patriots that I am designating ANTIFA, A SICK, DANGEROUS, RADICAL LEFT DISASTER, AS A MAJOR TERRORIST ORGANIZATION.” (9/17/25)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: Five days later, President Trump designated Antifa a domestic terrorist organization and directed every relevant agency to investigate, disrupt, and dismantle its illegal operations — including those who fund them.

  • PROMISE MADE: “We will rebuild our once great cities, including our capital in Washington, D.C., making them safe, clean, and beautiful again.” (1/19/25)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump mobilized the National Guard and is cracking down on crime with federal support for local police and cleanup initiatives for the nation’s capital, which has seen historic drops in violent crime, safer streets, and renewed economic vitality thanks to the Trump Administration’s historic public safety initiatives. In 2025, homicides in the District dropped 60% and carjackings dropped 68% — and the momentum has continued in 2026, with homicides down another 45%. The D.C. Safe and Beautiful Task Force has made more than 16,000 arrests and taken nearly 2,000 guns off the streets.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I am going to indemnify all police officers and law enforcement officials throughout the United States to protect them from being destroyed by the Radical Left lunatics who are angry that they’re taking strong action on crime.” (5/18/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump directed his Administration to provide legal resources and indemnification to law enforcement officers who unjustly incur expenses and liabilities for actions taken in the performance of their duties to keep Americans safe — and to empower local law enforcement with the resources they need to effectively serve their communities.

  • PROMISE MADE: “When I’m back in the White House, we will use every tool, lever, and authority to get the homeless off our streets.” (4/17/23)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump signed an Executive Order cracking down on the crime, disorder, and squalor that had plagued American streets for far too long — directing grants to communities that enforce bans on urban camping, loitering, squatting, and open drug use, and expanding civil commitment so those who are a danger to themselves and others get treatment instead of a tent on the sidewalk. In the nation’s capital, the results were powerful and immediate.

Defeating Inflation and Making America Affordable Again

  • PROMISE MADE: “Starting the day I take the oath of office, I will rapidly drive prices down and we will make America affordable again.” (8/17/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump is the only President to actually lower prescription drug prices, which just saw their sharpest drop in 63 years. Car insurance costs have also fallen since February and grocery prices declined in September — with the year-over-year increase in grocery prices now lower than the Fed’s target rate. The U.S. economy has added over a million private sector jobs, and the S&P 500 has repeatedly hit record highs.

  • PROMISE MADE: “We’re going to get your gas prices down.” (1/16/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: The national average for gasoline hit a four-year low under President Trump, dipping below $3 per gallon in December 2025. Now, amid a temporary disruption as the Iranian regime menaces the Strait of Hormuz, President Trump is aggressively fighting to bring prices back down, using the Defense Production Act to expand American refining capacity, cutting diesel costs for truckers and farmers, securing the release of more than 130 million barrels of diesel from foreign stockpiles, and boosting Venezuelan oil imports to their highest level in almost a decade.

  • PROMISE MADE: “Under my policy, the United States government will tell Big Pharma that we will only pay the best price they offer to foreign nations, who have been taking advantage of us for so long— the United States is tired of getting ripped off.” (06/22/23)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump signed an Executive Order demanding Most Favored Nation drug pricing and has secured deals with 26 pharmaceutical companies representing roughly 90% of the U.S. pharmaceutical market to guarantee Americans pay the same low prices other developed nations receive. He also launched the revolutionary TrumpRx.gov to connect patients directly with discounted medicines.

Delivering the Largest Tax Cuts in American History

  • PROMISE MADE: “We’re going to have very large tax cuts for workers and … No Tax on Tips, No Tax on Overtime.” (10/12/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: The Working Families Tax Cuts — the largest tax cut in history for working- and middle-class Americans, including No Tax on Tips, No Tax on Overtime, and No Tax on Social Security — is now the law of the land, delivering unprecedented tax relief for small businesses, farmers, workers, and families. In the first filing season, more than 53 million filers claimed at least one of President Trump’s signature new tax cuts and the average refund topped $3,400 — up 11%.

  • PROMISE MADE: “…when I get to office, we are going to not charge taxes on tips…” (6/9/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump delivered No Tax on Tips — and in the first filing season alone, more than six million filers claimed the new deduction, with an average deduction of more than $7,100.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I’m also announcing that as part of our additional tax cuts, we will end all taxes on overtime.” (9/12/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump delivered No Tax on Overtime for America’s hardest-working citizens — and more than 25 million filers claimed the new deduction in the first filing season, with an average deduction of more than $3,100.

  • PROMISE MADE: “SENIORS SHOULD NOT PAY TAX ON SOCIAL SECURITY!” (7/31/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump delivered a new enhanced deduction for seniors to cut taxes on Social Security — and more than 30 million seniors have already claimed it, with an average deduction of more than $7,500.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I am also announcing that as part of our tax cuts, we will make interest on car loans fully deductible.” (10/10/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump made interest on loans for new American-made vehicles deductible — and more than one million Americans have already deducted their car loan interest, with an average deduction of more than $1,800.

  • PROMISE MADE: “We will make the Trump tax cuts permanent and cut taxes even more for working families and small businesses.” (6/15/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: As part of the Working Families Tax Cuts, the 20% small business deduction was made permanent, cutting taxes for eight million small businesses by an average of $4,600 and slashing taxes for 12 million small businesses by nearly $7,000.

Igniting a Blue-Collar Boom and Restoring Fair Trade

  • PROMISE MADE: “A vote for President Donald J. Trump is a vote for prosperity.” (9/13/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump’s America First economic policy has created a windfall in the stock market, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500, and Nasdaq repeatedly hitting new record highs — including 28 record closes for the S&P 500 in 2026 alone — while business is booming and the economy grew at a 3.4% annual rate in the third quarter.

  • PROMISE MADE: “If I’m elected, the dollar is so secure. Your reserve currency is the strongest it’ll ever be.” (10/15/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: Through pro-growth policies and tough trade deals, President Trump has fortified the dollar’s dominance, preventing de-dollarization efforts abroad and ensuring it remains the global standard — boosting American economic power worldwide.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I will be a champion for the American worker, who has suffered under lopsided trade deals that have pillaged our country. That will end on my watch, and we will use tariffs to fight against unfair trade practices by other countries and foster our own industrial growth.” (11/3/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump has delivered better terms for American workers, farmers, and manufacturers by leveling the economic playing field with our trading partners. By using tariffs as leverage, President Trump secured new and improved trade agreements with major U.S. trading partners covering more than half of global GDP — including the United Kingdom, European Union, Japan, China, India, Republic of Korea, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines, and Cambodia.

  • PROMISE MADE: “We’re going to tariff the hell out of countries that have been taking advantage of us…” (11/3/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump has used tariffs as a strategic tool to rebuild American manufacturing, secure our supply chains, and protect U.S. national security. After decades of weak trade policies that allowed foreign nations to exploit our economy, close off certain markets to U.S. exports, and flood American markets with dumped goods, America is finally getting tough on trade and delivering results. When the Supreme Court ruled against his emergency tariffs, President Trump kept the pressure on, turning to Section 122, Section 232, and Section 301 tariffs to keep defending American workers.

  • PROMISE MADE: “We’re going to put very serious tariffs on Mexico and Canada because… The drugs that are coming through are at record numbers.” (1/7/25)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump kept his word, leveraging tariffs on Mexico and Canada to stop the flow of fentanyl and its precursor chemicals in their tracks and secure agreements with the two countries to work together to protect national security against these deadly drugs. Fentanyl trafficking at the southern border has collapsed by 56%, and President Trump signed the HALT Fentanyl Act to permanently classify fentanyl analogues as Schedule I drugs. As a result, drug overdose deaths have plunged to the lowest since 2017.

  • PROMISE MADE: “[China is] sending fentanyl into our country — and because of that, they’re causing us hundreds of thousands of deaths, so China is going to end up paying a tariff also for that… China has to stop sending fentanyl into our country and killing our people.” (1/30/25)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump utilized tariffs as a powerful tool to force China to commit to working with the U.S. to stop the flow of fentanyl and precursor chemicals — culminating in an historic meeting with President Xi Jinping, where the two leaders pledged cooperation on solving the problem. President Trump also designated illicit fentanyl and its core precursors as Weapons of Mass Destruction.

  • PROMISE MADE: “Together, we’re going to… bring thousands of factories back to the USA, right where they belong — and that will be done through tariffs and smart policy. We will build American, we will buy American, and we will hire American.” (1/19/25)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: As President Trump pursues his bold commitment to an America First trade agenda, companies and countries have committed tens of trillions in new investment in the U.S. — positioning the U.S. as the dominant player for the jobs of the future.

  • PROMISE MADE: “We are a nation whose once-revered airports are dirty, crowded mess… They don’t seek the qualified air traffic controllers and they just don’t know what the hell they’re doing.” (5/18/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump unveiled a plan to modernize America’s woefully outdated air traffic control system to keep travelers safe. With initial funding from the Working Families Tax Cuts, the FAA is replacing outdated radar, radios, software, and telecommunications equipment at more than 4,600 sites nationwide — the first step in building a brand-new air traffic control system for the American people. Meanwhile, the Trump Administration is also investing in modernizing our nation’s airports, including at Washington Dulles International Airport.

Putting America’s Farmers and Ranchers First

  • PROMISE MADE: “I will take immediate steps to defeat inflation, increase real farm incomes, and grow the agricultural economy by unleashing American energy, slashing wasteful government spending, and cutting burdensome regulation.” (2024)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump has delivered $12 billion in Farmer Bridge payments to American farmers hurt by unfair foreign trade practices and record input costs left by the Biden Administration, as well as historic farm safety net investments in the Working Families Tax Cuts, raising reference prices for major crops like soybeans, corn, and wheat by 10–21%.

  • PROMISE MADE: “To protect the pro-farmer tax cuts I delivered in 2017, including the elimination of the estate tax, or death tax, as well as the giant tax cut I gave to family farms… I will also make permanent the provisions of the Trump Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.” (2024)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: The Working Families Tax Cuts protect  family farms and ranches from the death tax by permanently raising the exemption and indexing it to inflation, so generational farm families aren’t forced to sell land, equipment, or livestock to pay the IRS.

  • PROMISE MADE: “When you buy apples, when you buy bacon, when you buy eggs, they would double and triple the price over a short period of time… We’re going to bring those prices way down.” (12/8/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: The Trump Administration launched a $1 billion plan to combat bird flu, protect America’s poultry flocks, and lower egg prices — resulting in the average price of a dozen eggs plunging more than 60%.

  • PROMISE MADE: “Just as I moved the Bureau of Land Management to Colorado, as many as 100,000 government positions can be moved out. And I mean immediately out of Washington to places filled with patriots who love America.” (3/21/23)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: The Trump Administration announced a sweeping reorganization of the Department of Agriculture, moving more than half of the D.C.-area workforce out of the swamp to locations nationwide — bringing the Department closer to the farmers and ranchers it serves.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I will once again stand up for Iowa ethanol…” (12/19/23)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: In 2025, the Trump Administration cleared summer sales of E15 nationwide, waived all federal barriers to E10, and implemented the highest-ever renewable fuel volume requirements.

Unleashing American Energy Dominance

  • PROMISE MADE: “We will stop the Biden-Harris war on American energy … American energy is such a big deal. We will drill, baby, drill.” (8/3/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump has unleashed American energy independence like never before, approving more drilling permits on federal lands than in any year in the past 15 years, lifting burdensome regulations, exporting to foreign countries, opening millions of acres for mining and drilling, terminating Biden-era preferential treatment for unreliable, foreign-controlled wind energy, and expanding pipelines — and as a result, U.S. oil and natural gas production surged to record levels in 2025 and is on track for another record in 2026.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I will immediately issue a national emergency declaration to achieve massive increase in domestic energy supply…” (9/5/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: On Day One, President Trump declared a national energy emergency to eliminate bureaucratic barriers, unleash innovation, and restore America’s position as the world’s leading energy producer.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I will sign Day One orders to… cancel [Biden’s] natural gas export ban.” (12/22/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump took executive action to lift the Biden-era freeze on gas exports and secured a $54 billion deal with Korea and Taiwan to build the long-stalled natural gas pipeline in Alaska.

  • PROMISE MADE: “[Biden] canceled the Keystone pipeline — 48,000 jobs and something that would have been fantastic for energy… It was a very important pipeline, actually, but we’ll get it open.” (9/7/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: In April 2026, President Trump signed a cross-border permit for a pipeline project that would revive large parts of the Keystone XL using idle Keystone XL pipe to carry Canadian oil to Wyoming.

  • PROMISE MADE: “We’re going to be opening up ANWR.” (1/7/25)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump freed up millions of acres within ANWR for oil and gas drilling and mining.

  • PROMISE MADE: “Banning offshore drilling will not stand. I will reverse it immediately.” (1/7/25)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump revoked Biden-era orders prohibiting offshore oil and gas leasing almost immediately after taking office and the Working Families Tax Cuts Act mandated a minimum of 30 offshore lease sales in the Gulf of America through 2040.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I told the European Union that they must make up their tremendous deficit with the United States by the large-scale purchase of our oil and gas. Otherwise, it is TARIFFS all the way!!!” (12/20/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump secured a historic commitment from the European Union to purchase $750 billion of American energy — and after the capture of Maduro, President Trump’s unprecedented Venezuela oil deal delivered its first million barrels to Texas in October 2026 at zero cost to taxpayers.

  • PROMISE MADE: “We have the minerals, but we don’t have the environmental impact statements — but we’ll make sure that that’s going to go very quickly. We’ll be able to do things that you never even thought.” (9/27/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump signed an Executive Order to fast-track mining permits and unlock domestic production of critical minerals. The Trump Administration also struck a key partnership with MP Materials to build America’s rare earth magnet supply chain and finally end American dependence on China.

Ending the Green New Scam

  • PROMISE MADE: “I will… end the Green New Scam.” (10/24/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump immediately targeted the costly Green New Scam through executive action, freezing funding to Radical Left climate programming that had zero accountability to taxpayers and drove energy costs up, while the Working Families Tax Cuts further repealed Green New Scam policies. The Trump Administration has also weeded out nonsense “climate” initiatives across the federal government.

  • PROMISE MADE: “We’re going to be ending the electric car mandate quickly.” (1/7/25)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump revoked the Biden-era electric vehicle mandate and fortified that action by signing three congressional resolutions into law ending California’s EV mandate and emission standards.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I’m immediately withdrawing from the unfair, one-sided Paris Climate Accord rip-off. The United States will not sabotage our own industries while China pollutes with impunity.” (1/20/25)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: On Day One, President Trump withdrew the U.S. from the Paris Climate Accord — and in January 2026, he pulled America out of 66 international organizations that promote radical climate policies and globalist ideologies. In February 2026, the Trump Administration eliminated the Obama-era 2009 Endangerment Finding in the single largest deregulatory action in U.S. history, saving American taxpayers over $1.3 trillion.

  • PROMISE MADE: “We are going to make sure that [offshore wind] ends on Day One. I’m going to write it out in an Executive Order.” (5/11/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: On Day One, President Trump withdrew every area of the Outer Continental Shelf from new offshore wind leasing and ordered a full review of the federal government’s wind leasing and permitting practices.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I will end all of these ridiculous quality of life-destroying mandates, just as I did just three-and-a-half years ago.” (5/1/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump scrapped the Biden-era showerhead water pressure rule, which unnecessarily restricted water pressure for Americans, and axed costly appliance efficiency mandates that drove up prices for American families.

Protecting America’s Land, Air, and Water

  • PROMISE MADE: “I want clean, beautiful air and clean, beautiful water. That’s all crystal clean water, and we want clean air.” (10/1/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump established the Make America Beautiful Again Commission to conserve America’s national parks, forests, waterways, and public lands, restore routine maintenance after years of neglect, and expand access for hunters, fishers, hikers, and outdoorsmen.

  • PROMISE MADE: “We want to get that water pouring down here as quickly as possible and let hundreds of millions of gallons of water flow down into Southern California.” (1/24/25)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: President Trump directed federal agencies to restart his first-term plan to route more water from the Sacramento–San Joaquin Delta to the Central Valley and Southern California, where farms and families desperately need a reliable water supply.

Slashing Red Tape and Draining the Swamp

  • PROMISE MADE: “To reduce costs for both manufacturers and consumers, I will remove ten old regulations for every new regulation.” (10/10/24)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: Last year, President Trump finalized an unprecedented 646 deregulatory actions compared to just five significant regulatory actions for a ratio of 129-to-1 — nearly 13 times the President’s 10-to-1 target — saving Americans an estimated $211.8 billion.

  • PROMISE MADE: “I will be signing an Executive Order next week ending the ridiculous Biden push for Paper Straws, which don’t work. BACK TO PLASTIC!” (2/7/25)
  • ✅ PROMISE KEPT: Three days later, President Trump signed an Executive Order ending the federal procurement and forced use of paper straws.

  • PROMISE MADE: “We’re going to go back to a merit system.” (8/29/24)
